title: cattleya labiata subvar. aurea
intro: Cattleya labiata subvar. aurea, commonly known as the Golden-lipped Cattleya, is a species of orchid native to the tropical forests of Central and South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs due to its expectorant properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of loosening and removing mucus from the airways. The health benefits of Cattleya labiata subvar. aurea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and alkaloids, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential of this plant.
